title: Yozma nutq: dars tahlili va baholash mezonlari
title_en: Writing: analysing criteria for assessing learner writing
prompt: O'quvchilarning yozma nutqini baholashda qanday mezonlardan foydalanish mumkin? O'z fikringizni 150–180 so'zda ilmiy-metodik tilda bayon eting. Kamida ikkita mezonni misol bilan izohlang.
prompt_en: Which criteria can be used to assess learners' writing? Give your view in 150–180 words in an academic-methodological register, illustrating at least two criteria with examples.
sample_structure: Kirish: yozma nutqni baholashdagi asosiy muammo (sub'ektivlik) va rubrikaning roli.
Asosiy qism: 2–3 ta mezon (mazmun, grammatik aniqlik, leksika, izchillik) va har biriga misol.
Xulosa: o'qituvchining xolis va shaffof baholashdagi mas'uliyati.

rubric.name: Mazmun va vazifa bajarilishi
rubric.descriptor_5: Barcha talablar bajarilgan, mezonlar misol bilan dalillangan
rubric.descriptor_3: Mezonlar sanalgan, lekin misol va asos yetarli emas
rubric.descriptor_1: Mavzudan chetga chiqilgan yoki juda qisqa

rubric.name: Grammatik aniqlik
rubric.descriptor_5: Xato deyarli yo'q, murakkab gaplar to'g'ri
rubric.descriptor_3: Bir nechta L1 ta'siridagi xato, ma'no tushunarli

title: Og'zaki nutq: pedagogik keys yechimi
prompt: Vaziyat: talabalar darsda passiv bo'lib qoldi. O'qituvchi sifatida ularni darsga jalb qilish metodlarini 1.5–2 daqiqa davomida ingliz tilida bayon eting. Kamida uchta aniq texnikani nomlang va asoslang.
prompt_en: Situation: students have become passive in class. As the teacher, explain in 1.5–2 minutes of spoken English how you would re-engage them, naming and justifying at least three concrete techniques.
sample_structure: Vaziyatni qisqa tavsiflash va mumkin bo'lgan sababni aytish (tashvish, qiziqish yo'qligi).
Uchta texnika: nima, qanday va nega ishlaydi.
Kutilayotgan natija va uni qanday tekshirish.

title: Tinglab tushunish: kasbiy ma'ruza tahlili
prompt: "Language Assessment Rubrics" audio parchasini (2 marta) tinglang. Ma'ruzachi aytgan uchta asosiy metodik tavsiyani ajrating va har biriga 2–3 gapli tahliliy izoh yozing (jami 100–130 so'z).
prompt_en: Listen (twice) to the excerpt "Language Assessment Rubrics". Identify the speaker's three main recommendations and write a 2–3 sentence analytical comment on each (100–130 words in total).

scaffold_vocabulary.term: signposting phrases (firstly, in addition, to sum up)

sample_structure: Birinchi tinglash: umumiy mavzu va ma'ruzachi maqsadi.
Ikkinchi tinglash: uchta tavsiya va kalit so'zlar.
Har bir tavsiya: nima deyilgan (parafraza) + sizning izohingiz.

title: O'qish: ilmiy-metodik maqola tahlili
title_en: Reading: critical analysis of a research article excerpt
prompt: "AI in Language Assessment" matnini diqqat bilan o'qing. (1) Muallifning asosiy tezisini bir gapda ifodalang; (2) u keltirgan ikkita dalilni ajrating; (3) o'zbek auditoriyasi uchun pedagogik xulosa chiqaring. Jami 120–150 so'z.
prompt_en: Read "AI in Language Assessment" carefully. (1) State the author's thesis in one sentence; (2) identify two supporting arguments; (3) draw a pedagogical implication for the Uzbek context. 120–150 words in total.
reading_text: Artificial Intelligence applications in English Language Teaching (ELT) offer diagnostic precision and real-time formative feedback. However, pedagogical mediation remains essential to foster metacognitive self-regulation. Where learners outsource the act of writing to generative tools, the very processes that assessment is meant to capture — planning, drafting, revising — are bypassed. Consequently, assessment designers increasingly distinguish between AI-assisted and AI-free tasks, reserving the latter for diagnosing genuine productive competence. Teachers, in turn, retain the final decision on how AI-generated feedback is interpreted and acted upon.
sample_structure: Xulosa: O'zbekiston OTM konteksti uchun ... tavsiya etiladi.
